text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for today!
Which race are you planning to enter next?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: If only I could run in the Arima Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I was hoping to enter that too!
If we end up racing together, I look forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Because getting to run with Rob Roy-san today
was so much fun...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: “...So this is... the Senior Class level...”

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...I learned my lesson today.
Next time, it won't end the same way.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yes. I can feel my own growth as well. I'm sure next time will yield an even better result.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Spe-san, Rob Roy-san.
I heard you both are aiming
to run in the Arima Kinen.
choice_data_list: Looks like we'll be facing each other again.
Looks like we'll be facing each other again.

text_block_list.text: Eishin Flash's next scheduled race is the Arima Kinen. If things continue like this, she'll clash with those two once again.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
choice_data_list: I got to race against the top two, so I'll be fine.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Even at the Arima Kinen, those two
will most likely be the biggest threats.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: In other words, all I have to do is surpass those two. —Simple and wonderful, isn't it?
